capabilities.name: Observe
capabilities.description: Notice details, watch routines, and detect inconsistencies. Playtest rating range 0–3.

capabilities.name: Deceive
capabilities.description: Maintain a cover, misdirect, and conceal intent. Playtest rating range 0–3.

capabilities.name: Infiltrate
capabilities.description: Gain access, move unnoticed, and bypass ordinary barriers. Playtest rating range 0–3.

capabilities.name: Analyze
capabilities.description: Interpret evidence, connect facts, and test a hypothesis. Playtest rating range 0–3.

capabilities.name: Influence
capabilities.description: Recruit, persuade, negotiate, and build trust. Playtest rating range 0–3.

capabilities.name: Operate
capabilities.description: Use tools, communications, codes, and technical systems. Playtest rating range 0–3.

rules.name: Approach allocation
rules.description: A new spy distributes 8 points among Observe, Deceive, Infiltrate, Analyze, Influence, and Operate. No approach may begin above 3. A rating of 0 means no particular training, not inability to attempt an action.

rules.name: Uncertain action resolution
rules.description: For meaningful uncertainty with consequences: establish intent, method, risk, approach, and a target number from 7 to 13; roll 2d6 and add the chosen approach rating. Do not roll when the outcome is already certain or for every routine movement.

rules.name: Uncertainty outcome bands
rules.description: Strong success: total is target +3 or more. Success: total meets or exceeds target. Mixed result: total is target -1 or -2. Miss: total is target -3 or less. Natural 2 and natural 12 are not automatic failure or success.

rules.name: Preparation and assets
rules.description: A justified asset may lower the target by 2, remove one specific obstacle, provide access, protect against one named consequence, or create a credible alternative route. A single action receives at most one target reduction from preparation or assets.

rules.name: Opportunity, suspicion, and response clocks
rules.description: A scene may track three optional four-box clocks: Opportunity, Suspicion, and Response. Mark boxes only when fiction warrants it. Mixed results may mark one relevant box; misses may mark one or two; strong successes may prevent a mark or clear one when justified. At four boxes, resolve the clock's stated consequence.

rules.name: Information and evidence distinctions
rules.description: Track world facts separately from player knowledge. Character information is classified as Observed, Inferred, Claimed, Verified, or Reported. An observation is not automatically proof; a report is not necessarily true.
